assets.business_significance: Ticket text, attachments and contact details drive customer service; exposure crosses customer boundaries.
The application enforces tenant access and presents customer tickets to authorized users.
Cloud configuration, networking and runtime permissions control the service availability and security.

assets.location: Identity service and system access lists
assets.business_significance: Identities, group membership and approvals determine who can access company information.
Code and release workflows determine the integrity of software shipped to customers.
Credential theft could permit production access or unauthorized releases.
Backups contain customer information and are needed to recover service after loss or corruption.
Devices hold work sessions and limited local information and can become an entry point.
Employment records, agreements and customer commitments require controlled handling.
A static brochure site supports inbound sales; it holds no logins, tickets, payment data or lead forms.

risks.title: Former employee retains ticket access
risks.event_and_consequence: An offboarding task is missed, allowing a former employee to read or export tickets.
risks.existing_safeguards: Manual leaver checklist; manager notifications are assumed but not reconciled to system exports.
risks.likelihood_rationale: The fixture contains an active departed user and manual handoffs recur at each departure.
risks.impact_rationale: Customer ticket exposure could harm multiple customers and trigger contractual investigation.
risks.target_rationale: Central leaver reconciliation and review reduce recurrence; an undetected account can still expose tickets.

risks.title: Unjustified privilege enables major compromise
risks.event_and_consequence: A compromised or misused privileged account changes infrastructure or repositories beyond its business need.
risks.existing_safeguards: Some named administrator approvals and MFA are assumed; privileged assignments are not reviewed systematically.
risks.likelihood_rationale: One unjustified repository administrator exists in the fixture and routine reviews are absent.
risks.impact_rationale: Privileged misuse could affect every tenant or the software release chain.
risks.target_rationale: Approval and strong authentication reduce exposure; a successful privileged compromise remains severe.

risks.title: Role change leaves excessive ticket permissions
risks.event_and_consequence: A sales employee retains support-agent permissions and accesses customer ticket content without a current need.
risks.existing_safeguards: Department role matrix exists as a fictional baseline; role-change triggers are informal.
risks.likelihood_rationale: Role changes occur periodically and the fixture shows one mismatch against approved access.
risks.impact_rationale: Inappropriate ticket access could expose customer conversations and attachments.
risks.target_rationale: Event-driven permission checks reduce recurrence; the impact of missed access remains unchanged.

risks.title: Lost laptop exposes work sessions
risks.event_and_consequence: A stolen laptop with an active session is used to access work information.
risks.existing_safeguards: Screen locking and limited local storage are assumed; encryption and remote-wipe coverage are not verified.
risks.likelihood_rationale: Remote staff carry devices and device safeguards lack a verified inventory.
risks.impact_rationale: A single device could expose a bounded set of work records and sessions.
risks.target_rationale: Verified encryption and session revocation make successful access less likely; exposed sessions still matter.

risks.title: Backups fail to restore after corruption
risks.event_and_consequence: Data corruption is followed by a failed restore, causing extended service loss or unrecoverable tickets.
risks.existing_safeguards: Nightly backups are assumed; no successful restore evidence or isolated recovery copy is available.
risks.likelihood_rationale: Backup jobs exist but recoverability has never been demonstrated in this scenario.
risks.impact_rationale: Failed recovery could cause prolonged all-customer outage and permanent ticket loss.
risks.target_rationale: A tested isolated restore and integrity checks reduce failure likelihood and bound the recovery consequence.

risks.title: Cloud disruption interrupts customer service
risks.event_and_consequence: A supplier or regional disruption interrupts the single-region service beyond customer tolerances.
risks.existing_safeguards: Supplier status monitoring is assumed; no tested service recovery arrangement exists.
risks.likelihood_rationale: A single-region dependency creates a credible interruption path without tested failover.
risks.impact_rationale: A multi-hour service interruption would prevent customer support and breach assumed service commitments.
risks.target_rationale: Redundancy and exercised recovery reduce prolonged interruption likelihood; a severe regional event still matters.

risks.title: Unsafe release weakens tenant isolation
risks.event_and_consequence: An inadequately reviewed change bypasses tenant authorization and exposes another customer's tickets.
risks.existing_safeguards: Peer review is assumed; required security tests and release approvals are not enforced.
risks.likelihood_rationale: Frequent changes and missing negative authorization tests create repeated opportunities.
risks.impact_rationale: Cross-tenant access can expose information across the customer base.
risks.target_rationale: Required reviews and tenant-isolation tests reduce unsafe releases; a missed defect remains severe.

risks.title: Supplier handles customer information improperly
risks.event_and_consequence: A support or hosting supplier retains or discloses customer data contrary to agreed handling expectations.
risks.existing_safeguards: Basic purchasing approvals are assumed; supplier data flows and security terms have not been reviewed.
risks.likelihood_rationale: Several suppliers handle information without a consistent security review.
risks.impact_rationale: Supplier disclosure could expose customer records and undermine commitments.
risks.target_rationale: Due diligence and contractual handling conditions reduce exposure; supplier breaches remain possible.

risks.title: Slow incident response increases harm
risks.event_and_consequence: Unclear escalation and missing investigation records delay containment of suspicious access.
risks.existing_safeguards: Staff can contact the Platform Lead; no exercised incident procedure or consistent event review exists.
risks.likelihood_rationale: Ad hoc escalation and incomplete logging make delayed recognition plausible.
risks.impact_rationale: An uncontained incident can increase ticket exposure and extend downtime.
risks.target_rationale: Logging and exercised escalation reduce delay and limit incident duration; detection is still imperfect.

risks.title: Exposed build secret permits production access
risks.event_and_consequence: A service secret copied into source or build output is obtained and used to access production.
risks.existing_safeguards: A secrets store is assumed; legacy shared tokens and inconsistent scanning remain.
risks.likelihood_rationale: Build and support workflows create recurring copying opportunities with incomplete detection.
risks.impact_rationale: A high-impact secret may enable broad production access or an unauthorized release.
risks.target_rationale: Scoped short-lived credentials, rotation and scanning reduce exposure; a missed powerful secret remains severe.

risks.title: People records shared with the wrong group
risks.event_and_consequence: An overly broad document link exposes employment records to colleagues without a business need.
risks.existing_safeguards: Separate people folder and small authorized group are assumed; link sharing is not periodically checked.
risks.likelihood_rationale: Few record handlers reduce frequency, but unchecked sharing remains a plausible route.
risks.impact_rationale: Exposure would affect a bounded set of employee personal information and trust.
risks.target_rationale: Restricted links and periodic review reduce accidental access; disclosed people records still have material impact.

risks.title: Brief public website outage delays enquiries
risks.event_and_consequence: A brief outage of the separate static marketing website delays prospective customer enquiries.
risks.existing_safeguards: Managed hosting and static content are assumed; existing customers use a separate service URL and email.
risks.likelihood_rationale: A small static site with managed hosting presents limited ordinary outage exposure.
risks.impact_rationale: Only short-term enquiry delay is expected; customer service and customer data are unaffected.
risks.target_rationale: Accept within low-risk appetite while monitoring scope and business dependency changes.

treatments.action: Remove stale access; connect leaver notifications to system-owner confirmation; test a second leaver sample.
treatments.required_evidence: Full leaver reconciliation, revocation records and a repeat-cycle review.
treatments.acceptance_authority: Risk owner; target acceptance pending evidence

treatments.action: Review privileged accounts; require independent approval and strong MFA; retain and monitor necessary administration.
treatments.required_evidence: Approved privileged list, MFA coverage, activity logs and a repeat review.
treatments.acceptance_authority: Risk owner and CEO; target remains High, approval pending

treatments.action: Downgrade the sampled account; require a role-change access check and quarterly owner review.
treatments.required_evidence: Role-change tickets, approved role matrix and review results.
treatments.acceptance_authority: Risk owner; target acceptance pending evidence

treatments.action: Verify managed-device encryption and lock settings; document loss reporting and session revocation; test one device.
treatments.required_evidence: Device compliance export, training record and loss-response test.
treatments.acceptance_authority: Risk owner; target acceptance pending evidence

treatments.action: Set recovery targets; isolate a recovery copy; restore a sample and validate data integrity and elapsed time.
treatments.required_evidence: Timed restore log, recovered-data checks and owner review against recovery targets.
treatments.acceptance_authority: Risk owner; target acceptance pending evidence

treatments.action: Review supplier resilience; design redundancy and a recovery runbook; exercise the recovery decision.
treatments.required_evidence: Supplier resilience assessment and recovery exercise with timing.
treatments.acceptance_authority: Risk owner; target acceptance pending evidence

treatments.action: Require peer approval, tenant-boundary tests, dependency checks and documented release rollback.
treatments.required_evidence: Protected change workflow, failed-access tests, release approval and rollback record.
treatments.acceptance_authority: Risk owner and CEO; target remains High, approval pending

treatments.action: List data-processing suppliers; assess access, retention, incident notice and deletion commitments; record gaps.
treatments.required_evidence: Supplier assessment, data-flow inventory and reviewed contractual commitments.
treatments.acceptance_authority: Risk owner; target acceptance pending evidence

treatments.action: Define incident roles and escalation; specify logging coverage; run an incident tabletop and preserve records.
treatments.required_evidence: Incident playbook, log-coverage review and tabletop timeline.
treatments.acceptance_authority: Risk owner; target acceptance pending evidence

treatments.action: Inventory service credentials; reduce scope; rotate exposed or shared tokens; add secret scanning and response steps.
treatments.required_evidence: Secret inventory without values, rotation record and scanner test using a harmless dummy token.
treatments.acceptance_authority: Risk owner and CEO; target remains High, approval pending

treatments.action: Review people-folder permissions and external links; define classification and handling instructions.
treatments.required_evidence: Folder permission review, sharing configuration and handling briefing.
treatments.acceptance_authority: Risk owner; target acceptance pending evidence

treatments.action: Accept for this simulation; monitor host alerts; reconsider if customer login, forms or higher revenue dependency is added.
treatments.required_evidence: Owner acceptance record and scheduled review; no claimed new implementation.

controls.justification: The company needs a documented policy and responsibilities to direct risk decisions.
controls.status_basis: Policy is drafted; no real approval or communication took place.
controls.required_evidence: Approved policy and staff acknowledgement.

controls.justification: Named asset owners are needed to evaluate information dependencies.
controls.status_basis: Ten assets are inventoried in the case study; completeness is not operationally verified.
controls.required_evidence: Validated asset inventory with owner review.

controls.justification: Service credentials can expose production if copied or left shared.
controls.status_basis: Secrets inventory and rotation evidence are absent.
controls.required_evidence: Credential lifecycle procedure, scoped access and rotation logs.

controls.justification: Leavers, role changes and shared folders require permission decisions.
controls.status_basis: Synthetic access review completed; recurring and organization-wide operation is unverified.
controls.required_evidence: Approval, review and revocation records across all relevant systems.

controls.justification: Data handling suppliers require assessed security expectations.
controls.status_basis: Supplier assessments and reviewed terms are absent.
controls.required_evidence: Supplier risk review and agreed handling conditions.

controls.justification: Cloud use creates service and data dependencies even when operation is outsourced.
controls.status_basis: Cloud responsibility and exit reviews are absent.
controls.required_evidence: Cloud responsibility matrix, service review and exit plan.

controls.justification: Ad hoc reporting needs a defined escalation path.
controls.status_basis: Incident procedure and tabletop evidence are absent.
controls.required_evidence: Incident roles, escalation criteria and exercise records.

controls.justification: Containment and recovery decisions must be timely and recorded.
controls.status_basis: No incident-response exercise has been performed.
controls.required_evidence: Investigation timeline, containment decisions and recovery review.

controls.justification: Service and data recovery need tested business-driven targets.
controls.status_basis: Recovery arrangements have not been exercised.
controls.required_evidence: Approved recovery targets and timed exercise results.

controls.justification: Tickets and people records contain personal information.
controls.status_basis: Jurisdiction and binding obligations require future validation.
controls.required_evidence: Verified obligations register and data-handling rules.

controls.justification: Staff must understand loss reporting and safe information sharing.
controls.status_basis: The portfolio learning guide is not company staff-training evidence.
controls.required_evidence: Role-based training attendance and understanding checks.

controls.justification: Employment changes must trigger updated access and responsibilities.
controls.status_basis: One departed account was corrected in synthetic records; end-to-end HR operation remains planned.
controls.required_evidence: HR trigger, system-owner confirmation and recurring reconciliation.

controls.justification: Remote employees use company devices outside company premises.
controls.status_basis: Home-working device protection is assumed, not evidenced.
controls.required_evidence: Offsite handling instructions and device accountability.

controls.justification: Laptops can expose work sessions and stored information.
controls.status_basis: Encryption and management coverage are unverified.
controls.required_evidence: Device configuration and compliance reports.

controls.justification: Powerful permissions must be justified and independently approved.
controls.status_basis: One unnecessary admin role removed; one approved cloud admin retained in synthetic records.
controls.required_evidence: Privileged approvals, least-privilege review and activity monitoring.

controls.justification: Human and service identities protect sensitive systems.
controls.status_basis: MFA coverage and service authentication are not technically tested.
controls.required_evidence: Authentication settings, coverage report and test results.

controls.justification: Reliable cloud settings support resilience and prevent unintended changes.
controls.status_basis: A configuration baseline is not evidenced.
controls.required_evidence: Approved baseline, drift review and change records.

controls.justification: Ticket recovery requires more than a successful scheduled backup job.
controls.status_basis: No restore has been run in this portfolio.
controls.required_evidence: Backup results, isolated copy and integrity-checked restore.

controls.justification: Privileged changes and incidents need usable records.
controls.status_basis: Log coverage, retention and review are not demonstrated.
controls.required_evidence: Log coverage matrix, protected records and review evidence.

controls.justification: Tenant isolation and build credentials need security throughout development.
controls.status_basis: Security requirements and checks are proposed.
controls.required_evidence: Security acceptance criteria and tests across the development lifecycle.

controls.justification: Production changes require review and recoverability.
controls.status_basis: Release and rollback evidence are not present.
controls.required_evidence: Approved change, test outcome and rollback record.
